description: Doubao WLED Light Recipe Skill - config file. Copy to config.json and fill in your values.

wled.note: Leave ip/mdns_name empty to enable auto-discovery. Or fill in your WLED IP for faster connection. Example: ip=192.168.1.100, mdns_name=wled-ab12cd

layout.description: LED strip layout type: tv_backlight, linear, ring, or matrix
layout.note: Set total_leds and edges to match your physical LED strip. total_leds=0 means auto-detect from device. For tv_backlight, fill top/bottom/left/right LED counts.

adb.note: Optional: ADB device address for pushing recipe images to screen (e.g. Android TV, amplifier with screen). Set device to '192.168.2.43:5555' format. Leave empty to open images locally instead.
